en-US: Same app as build 25, now built and uploaded by GitHub Actions. Settings has a Language option (System, English, Simplified Chinese) that applies the next time EOF opens, and .ts files open as TypeScript code.
zh-Hans: 与 build 25 的 App 相同，这一版改由 GitHub Actions 构建和上传。设置里的「语言」选项（跟随系统、English、简体中文）在下次打开 EOF 时生效，.ts 文件作为 TypeScript 代码打开。
